literal: Despising (and) without mocking, those who give (acc.) if seen, having rejoiced, mind inside-inside rejoicing it possesses.
translation: If one sees those who give without scorn or mockery, the mind will rejoice and feel delight deep within.
modern: தன்னை இகழ்ந்து ஏளனம் செய்யாமல் பொருள் கொடுப்பவரைக் கண்டால், இரப்பவரின் உள்ளம் மகிழ்ந்து தனக்குள்ளே பெருமகிழ்ச்சி அடையும்.
explanation: This couplet describes the profound joy of a person in need when they encounter a truly gracious giver. The words 'இகழ்ந்து' (scorning) and 'எள்ளாது' (without mocking) highlight the usual humiliation associated with asking for help. In Tamil syntax, the negative in the second word applies to the first as well, meaning 'without scorning and mocking'. When a giver provides without this disdain, the receiver's reaction is not just relief, but deep emotional happiness. The repetition in 'உள்ளுள்' (deep within) emphasizes that this joy penetrates to the very core of their heart, restoring their dignity.
